rules: Profile version numbers do not imply semantic maturity.
Self-tested does not imply external execution.
External-source-reviewed does not imply the source project reviewed the mapping.
Queued workflows do not count as externally-executed.
Our own repositories do not count as externally-consumed.
Externally-reproduced requires an unrelated reproducer and durable public evidence.
Externally-consumed requires an unrelated project to make the profile/verifier part of its own CI, release, evidence, or review process.
